Interface Description

Related Interfaces

On the web page loaded by the web-view component, the interface provided by the JS SDK can be used to invoke the miniprogram-related capabilities.

The following interfaces are supported:

Interface Name Description
ma.miniProgram.navigateTo The event is not supported. The parameters are the same as other parameters of the miniprogram interface(DSL mini-program only,for details, please refer to Introduction).
ma.miniProgram.navigateBack The delta parameter is required. If the delta parameter is not transferred, the value is 1(DSL mini-program only,for details, please refer to Introduction).
ma.miniProgram.switchTab The parameters are consistent with the miniprogram interface(DSL mini-program only,for details, please refer to Introduction).
ma.miniProgram.redirectTo The parameters are consistent with the miniprogram interface(DSL mini-program only,for details, please refer to Introduction).
ma.miniProgram.reLaunch The parameters are consistent with the miniprogram interface(DSL mini-program only,for details, please refer to Introduction).
ma.miniProgram.getEnv Obtains the current environment. You can use the window._majs_environment variable to determine whether the environment is in the miniprogram.
ma.miniProgram.close Close miniprogram, no callback
ma.chooseImage Select pictures from your local album or take pictures with your camera.
ma.chooseVideo Take a video or select a video from your phone's album(The minimum version of this interface is 24.9.0)
ma.getLocation Obtain the current geographical location information.
ma.previewImage Preview Picture
ma.getsmallappinfo Obtain basic information of the Mini Program (The minimum version of this interface is 23.12.0)
ma.openDocument Open File
ma.getStorage The parameters are consistent with the miniprogram interface.
ma.setStorage The parameters are consistent with the miniprogram interface.
ma.removeStorage The parameters are consistent with the miniprogram interface.
ma.clearStorage The parameters are consistent with the miniprogram interface.
ma.getNetworkType Obtaining the Network Status
ma.scanCode Pull up the QR code to scan, also support the one-dimensional code.
ma.callNativeAPI Invoke the native method in HTML5. (The earliest version of this interface is 23.3.0.)
ma.native Invoke native capabilities. (The earliest version of this interface is 23.3.0.)
ma.request Request sending interface (The earliest version of this interface is 23.12. 0)
ma.uploadFile Upload interface (The earliest version of this interface is 23.12. 0)
ma.downloadFile Download interface (The earliest version of this interface is 23.12. 0)
ma.reportLog Developer-defined log reporting interface (The earliest version of this interface is 23.12. 0)
ma.reportPerformance Developer-defined indicator reporting interface (The earliest version of this interface is 23.12. 0)
ma.submitReport Log reporting triggered by a developer (The earliest version of this interface is 23.12. 0)
ma.isOnline Determine the Mini Program’s networking status (The minimum version of this interface is 23.12.0)
ma.playAudio Play audio (minimum version of this interface is 23.12.0)
ma.stopAudio Stop playing audio (minimum version of this interface is 23.12.0)
ma.navigateToMiniProgram Jump to other Mini Programs within a Mini Program (minimum version of this interface is 23.12.0)
ma.getBackgroundFetchData Get all the data in the data pre-fetch cache (minimum version of this interface is 23.12.0)
ma.getLaunchOptionsSync Get the startup parameters when starting the miniprogram (minimum version of this interface is 23.12.0)
ma.getStatusBarHeight Get status bar height (The minimum version of this interface is 24.3.0)
ma.capsuleStyle Set capsule style (The minimum version of this interface is 24.3.0)
ma.gotoBrowser Jump to third-party browsing (The minimum version of this interface is 24.3.0)
ma.saveFileToPhone Save base64 to the mobile phone (the storage can be accessed by users) (The minimum version of this interface is 24.3.0)
ma.saveImage Save picture to photo album (The minimum version of this interface is 24.3.0)
ma.saveBase64Image Save base64 to album (The minimum version of this interface is 24.3.0)
ma.chooseContact Get the mobile phone address book and select the contact (The minimum version of this interface is 24.3.0)
ma.showToast Show message box (The minimum version of this interface is 24.3.0)
ma.showLoading The loading prompt box is displayed and needs to be actively called ma.hideLoading to close it. (The minimum version of this interface is 24.3.0)
ma.hideLoading Hide loading prompt box (The minimum version of this interface is 24.3.0)
ma.getAuthCode Call the interface to obtain login credentials. Obtain user login status information through credentials (The minimum version of this interface is 24.3.0)
ma.getOpenUserInfo Call the interface to obtain user public information (The minimum version of this interface is 24.3.0)
ma.openBluetoothAdapter Initialize Bluetooth module(The minimum version of this interface is 24.6.0)
ma.closeBluetoothAdapter Turn off the Bluetooth module(The minimum version of this interface is 24.6.0)
ma.startBluetoothDevicesDiscovery Start searching for nearby Bluetooth peripherals(The minimum version of this interface is 24.6.0)
ma.stopBluetoothDevicesDiscovery Stop searching for nearby Bluetooth peripherals(The minimum version of this interface is 24.6.0)
ma.onBluetoothDeviceFound Listen for events when new devices are found(The minimum version of this interface is 24.6.0)
ma.offBluetoothDeviceFound Remove the global listening function for the event of new device being searched(The minimum version of this interface is 24.6.0)
ma.createBLEConnection Connect Bluetooth Low Energy devices(The minimum version of this interface is 24.6.0)
ma.closeBLEConnection Disconnect from Bluetooth Low Energy device(The minimum version of this interface is 24.6.0)
ma.getBLEDeviceServices Get all services of Bluetooth low energy devices(The minimum version of this interface is 24.6.0)
ma.getBLEDeviceCharacteristics Get all characteristics of a service of a Bluetooth low energy device(The minimum version of this interface is 24.6.0)
ma.writeBLECharacteristicValue Write binary data to Bluetooth Low Energy device characteristics(The minimum version of this interface is 24.6.0)
ma.exitMiniProgram exit the current miniProgram (minimum version: 24.6.0)
ma.reportEvent Incident reporting (minimum version: 24.6.0)
ma.setStorageSync Stores data in the specified key in the local cache. The original content corresponding to the key is overwritten(minimum version: 24.9.0)
ma.getStorageSync Synchronously Obtaining Content with a Specified Key from the Local Cache(minimum version: 24.9.0)
ma.onScreenRecordingStateChanged Listening to Screen Recording Events(minimum version: 24.9.0,Supported on: iOS only)
ma.offScreenRecordingStateChanged Remove Listener Screen Recording Event(minimum version: 24.9.0,Supported on: iOS only)
ma.deauthorize Cancel all authorization information of the current miniprogram(minimum version: 24.9.0)
ma.cancelAuthorize Cancel part of the authorization information of the current miniprogram(minimum version: 24.9.0)
ma.onKeyboardHeightChange Listening function for keyboard height change events（minimum version: 24.9.0）
ma.offKeyboardHeightChange Removes the listening function for the keyboard height change event（minimum version: 24.9.0）
ma.setClipboardData Sets the content of the system clipboard. (The earliest version of this interface is 24.12.0)
ma.getClipboardData Obtains the content of the system clipboard. (The earliest version of this interface is 24.12.0)
ma.arrayBufferToBase64 Convert an ArrayBuffer object to a Base64 character string. (**The earliest version of this interface is 24.12.0 **)
ma.base64ToArrayBuffer Converts a Base64 character string to an ArrayBuffer object. (The earliest version of this interface is 24.12. 0)
ma.getSystemSetting Obtain device settings. (The earliest version of this interface is 24.12.0)
ma.setCapsuleShow CapsuleHide (The earliest version of this interface is 25.3.0)
ma.setCustomEvent Register a custom event for your mini-program to trigger a callback in a specified scenario (Minimum version of this interface is 25.12.0).
ma.removeCustomEvent Remove custom event listeners for mini-programs (Minimum version of this interface is 25.12.0)
ma.setSwipeBack Sets whether to disable iOS gesture control. Note: This API is called by an H5 mini program to control whether sliding is supported globally, or called by a DSL mini program to control whether sliding is supported on the current page.(Minimum version of this interface is 26.3.0，effective only on iOS devices)

Unique APIS

JS SDK has unique interfaces and related instructions compared to DSL basic API

ma.postMessage(Any message)

Sending information from an H5 application embedded in a web-view component to a mini-program (minimum version: 25.12.0)

Any message

Message to be sent

ma.onMessage(Function listener)

Listen for messages sent from the mini-program to the H5 application (minimum version: 25.12.0)

Function listener

Listener function executed when a message is sent by the mini-program

ma.setCapsuleShow(Object object)

Sets whether to hide the capsule (minimum version: 25.3.0)

Object object
Attribute Type Default value Mandatory Description
isShow Boolean true No Whether to display the capsule (false: no; true: yes)
success Function No Callback function that is successfully invoked.
fail Function No Callback function that fails to be invoked.
complete Function No Callback function that ends the interface invoking. (The function is executed when the interface is successfully invoked or fails to be invoked.)

ma.getSystemSetting()

Get device settings (minimum version: 24.12. 0)

Object res
Attribute Type Description
bluetoothEnabled Boolean Bluetooth system switch
locationEnabled Boolean Geographical location system switch
Wi-FiEnabled Boolean Wi-Fi system switch
deviceOrientation String The valid value can be portrait or landscape, indicating the device direction. (Note: The deviceOrientation obtained for landscape games on iOS clients may be inaccurate. You are advised to use the screen width and height.)

ma.base64ToArrayBuffer(string base64)

Convert Base64 strings to ArrayBuffer objects (minimum version: 24.12.0)

Return value

ArrayBuffer

ArrayBuffer object

ArrayBuffer ma.arrayBufferToBase64(ArrayBuffer arrayBuffer)

Convert ArrayBuffer object to Base64 string (minimum version: 24.12.0)

Return value

string

Base64 string

ma.getClipboardData(Object object)

Get the contents of the system clipboard (minimum version: 24.12. 0)

Object object
Attribute Type Default value Mandatory Description

ma.setClipboardData(Object object)

Set the contents of the system clipboard. After the interface is invoked successfully, a toast message is displayed, indicating that the content has been copied. The message lasts for 1.5 seconds (the earliest version is 24.12. 0).

Attribute Type Default value Mandatory Description

success Function No Callback function that is successfully invoked.
fail Function No Callback function that fails to be invoked.
complete Function No Callback function that ends the interface invoking. (This function is executed when the interface is successfully invoked or fails to be invoked.)

Listening for Keyboard Height Change Events (minimum version: 24.12.0)

Attribute Type Description

ma.offKeyboardHeightChange(function listener)

Removes the listening function for the keyboard height change event (minimum version: 24.12.0)

ma.deauthorize(Object object)

Cancel all authorization information of the current miniprogram (The minimum version of this interface is 24.9.0)

Parameter
Object object
Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
success Function No Callback function when the interface is successfully invoked.
fail Function No Callback function for interface invoking failure.
complete Function No Callback function when the interface invoking is complete (regardless of whether the invoking is successful)
object.success
Attribute Type Description
errMsg String deauthorize: ok
object.fail
Attribute Type Description

success Function No Callback function when the interface is successfully invoked.
fail Function No Callback function for interface invoking failure.

object.fail

ma.callNativeAPI(apiName:string,param:object,callback)

To call native capabilities, callback needs to be processed using promise syntax

API name called

ma.saveFileToPhone(Object object)

Save base64 to the mobile phone (the storage can be accessed by users) (The minimum version of this interface is 24.3.0)

Used to save Base64-encoded file data to the local storage of a mobile device. On Android, files are saved by default in the device's public Downloads directory (Downloads/). In iOS, files are stored within the app's sandbox directory, and users cannot directly access them through the Files app. To enable file preview functionality, the openDocument interface must be utilized.

If the image is accessed through this interface, it is best to configure openSharePanel (The configuration is available in version 25.9.0 and lower） to directly save to the album for the convenience of the customer.

Parameter
Object object
Attribute Type Mandatory or Not Description
content String Yes base64 encoding
fileName String Yes file name
openSharePanel Boolean No Default is false,Set to true to invoke the system share panel after saving the file (iOS only)
success Function No Callback function that is successfully invoked.
fail Function No Callback function that fails to be invoked.
complete Function No Callback function that ends the interface invoking. (This function is executed when the interface is successfully invoked or fails to be invoked.)
Return Value

Object object

Attribute Type Description
result String saved results
filePath String saved file path
path String saved file path(This path is used when ma.openDocument is invoked to open the file.)

Sample Code for Invoking APIs

Sample Maml Code

<web-view src="https://example/jssdk/calc/index.html"></web-view>

H5 API Call Code Example

<script>
  var vConsole = new VConsole();
  ma.miniProgram.getEnv((res) => {
    console.log(JSON.stringify(res));
  });

  ma.onMessage((res) => {
     console.log(res)
  });

  function postMessage() {
     ma.postMessage({ 'sendToMiniProgram': '0' });
  }
  
  ma.createTimer({
     duration: 10,
     success: (res) => {
        console.log(res);
     },
     fail: (res) => {
        console.log(res);
     }
  })
  ma.cancelTimer({
     success: (res) => {
        console.log(res);
     },
     fail: (res) => {
        console.log(res);
     }
  })
  //Sets whether to disable iOS gesture control.
  function setSwipeBack () {
     ma.setSwipeBack({
        enableSwipeBack: true,
        success: () => {
           console.log(`setSwipeBack success`);
           resolve();
        },
        fail: (err) => {
           console.error(`setSwipeBack fail`);
           reject(err);
        }
     });
  }
  //Capsule show
  ma.setCapsuleShow({
     isShow: false,
     success(res) {
        console.log(res);
     },
     fail(res) {
        console.log(res);
     },
     complete(res) {
        console.log(res);
     }
  });
  //Set the contents of the system clipboard
  ma.setClipboardData({
     data: 'data',
     success (res) {
        ma.getClipboardData({
           success (res) {
              console.log(res.data);
           }
        });
     }
  });
  //Gets the contents of the system clipboard
  ma.getClipboardData({
     success (res){
        console.log(res.data)
     }
  });
  //ArrayBuffer ma.base64ToArrayBuffer(string base64)
  const base64 = 'CxYh';
  const arrayBuffer = ma.base64ToArrayBuffer(base64);
  //ArrayBuffer ma.arrayBufferToBase64(ArrayBuffer arrayBuffer)
  const arrayBuffer = new Uint8Array([11, 22, 33]);
  const base64 = ma.arrayBufferToBase64(arrayBuffer);
  //Get Device Settings
  const systemSetting = ma.getSystemSetting();

  console.log(systemSetting.bluetoothEnabled);
  console.log(systemSetting.deviceOrientation);
  console.log(systemSetting.locationEnabled);
  console.log(systemSetting.wifiEnabled);
  //Listening function for keyboard height change events
  ma.onKeyboardHeightChange(res => {
     console.log(res.height);
  });
  //Disabling listening
  const listener = function (res) {
     console.log(res);
  };

  ma.onKeyboardHeightChange(listener);
  // The same function object as that used during listening must be transferred.
  ma.offKeyboardHeightChange(listener);
  
  // Cancel all listening.
  ma.offKeyboardHeightChange();

  //Select a video from the local album or use the camera to shoot.
  ma.chooseVideo({
     sourceType: ['album', 'camera'],
     success(res) {
        console.log(res.tempFilePath);
        console.log(res.tempFileVirtualPath);console.log(res.tempFileVirtualPath);
        console.log(res.duration);
        console.log(res.size);
        console.log(res.height);
        console.log(res.width);
     }
  });
  //Cancel part of the authorization information of the current miniprogram
  function cancelAuthorize () {
      ma.cancelAuthorize({
          scopes: ['scope.location'],
          success: () => {
              console.log(`Authorization canceled successfully`);
              resolve();
          },
          fail: (err) => {
              console.error(`Failed to cancel the authorization`);
              reject(err);
          }
      });
  }
  //Cancel all authorization information of the current miniprogram
  function deauthorize () {
      ma.deauthorize({
          success: () => {
              console.log(`All authorizations canceled successfully`);
              resolve();
          },
          fail: (err) => {
              console.error(`Failed to cancel all authorizations`);
              reject(err);
          }
      });
  }
  
  // Listening to Screen Recording Events
  const handlingEvent = function () {
     console.log('start listening');
  }
  function onScreenRecordingStateChanged() {
     ma.onScreenRecordingStateChanged(handlingEvent);
  }

  // Canceling Listening on Screen Recording Events
  function offScreenRecordingStateChanged() {
     ma.offScreenRecordingStateChanged(handlingEvent);
  }
  
  function setStorageSync() {
    try {
      ma.setStorageSync('key', 'data');
    } catch (e) {
      console.log(e);
    }
  }

  function getStorageSync() {
    try {
      const val = ma.getStorageSync('key');
      console.log('res', val.data);
    } catch (e) {
      console.log(e);
    }
  }



  function reportEvent() {
     const eventId = 'your eventId';
     ma.reportEvent(eventId);
  }

  function exitMiniProgram() {
     ma.exitMiniProgram({
        clearCache: false,
        success: (res) => {
           console.log(res);
        },
        fail: (err) => {
           console.log(err);
        }
     });
  }


  function writeBLECharacteristicValue() {
     let buffer = new ArrayBuffer(1)
     let dataView = new DataView(buffer)
     dataView.setUint8(0, 0)

     ma.writeBLECharacteristicValue({
        deviceId,
        serviceId,
        characteristicId,
        value: buffer,
        success(res) {
           console.log('writeBLECharacteristicValue success', res.errMsg)
        }
     })
  }

  function getBLEDeviceCharacteristics() {
     ma.getBLEDeviceCharacteristics({
        deviceId: 'deviceId',
        serviceId: 'serviceId',
        success: (res) => {
           console.log(res);
           for (let i = 0; i < res.characteristics.length; i++) {
              const item = res.characteristics[i]
              if (item.properties.read) {
                 ma.readBLECharacteristicValue({
                    deviceId,
                    serviceId,
                    characteristicId: item.uuid,
                 })
              }
              if (item.properties.write) {
                 console.log('write')
                 this.writeBLECharacteristicValue()
              }
           }
        },
        fail(res) {
           console.log(res);
        }
     })
  }

  function getBLEDeviceServices() {
     ma.getBLEDeviceServices({
        deviceId: 'deviceId',
        success: (res) => {
           console.log(res);
        },
        fail: (res) => {
           console.log(res);
        }
     })
  }

  function closeBLEConnection() {
     ma.closeBLEConnection({
        deviceId: 'deviceId',
        success: (res) => {
           console.log(res);
        },
        fail: (res) => {
           console.log(res);
        }
     })
  }

  function createBLEConnection() {
     ma.createBLEConnection({
        deviceId: 'deviceId',
        success: (res) => {
           console.log(res);
        },
        fail: (res) => {
           console.log(res);
        }
     })
  }

  function offBluetoothDeviceFound() {
     ma.offBluetoothDeviceFound();
  }

  function onBluetoothDeviceFound() {
     ma.onBluetoothDeviceFound((res) => {
        console.log(res);
     })
  }

  function stopBluetoothDevicesDiscovery() {
     ma.stopBluetoothDevicesDiscovery({
        success(res) {
           console.log(res);
        }
     })
  }

  function startBluetoothDevicesDiscovery() {
     ma.startBluetoothDevicesDiscovery({
        success(res) {
           console.log(res);
        }
     })
  }

  function closeBluetoothAdapter() {
     ma.closeBluetoothAdapter({
        success(res) {
           console.log(res);
        }
     })
  }

  function openBluetoothAdapter() {
     ma.openBluetoothAdapter({
        success(res) {
           console.log(res.state);
        }
     })
  }

  function getOpenUserInfo() {
     ma.getOpenUserInfo({
        success: function(res) {
           console.log(res.userInfo.nickName);
           console.log(res.userInfo.avatarUrl);
           console.log(res.userInfo.country);
        },
        fail: function(err) {
           console.log(err);
        }
     });
  }

  function getAuthCode() {
     ma.getAuthCode({
        scopes: [], // The scope of authority is subject to the current site operation definition; this is for illustration purposes only.
        success: function(res) {
           console.log(res);
        },
        fail: function(err) {
           console.log(err);
        }
     });
  }

  function hideLoading() {
     ma.hideLoading({
        success: function(res) {
           console.log(res);
        },
        fail: function(err) {
           console.log(err);
        }
     });
  }

  function showLoading() {
     ma.showLoading({
        title: 'loading...'
     });

     setTimeout(function () {
        ma.hideLoading();
     }, 2000);
  }

  function chooseContact() {
     ma.chooseContact({
        success(res) {
           console.log(res.phoneNumber);
           console.log(res.displayName);
        }
     })
  }

  function showToast() {
     // Support promise
     ma.showToast({
        title: 'xxxx'
     }).then(res => {
        console.log(res);
     });

     // Support callback
     ma.showToast({
        title: 'success',
        message: 'success' // 'message' attribute has the same effect as 'title', but 'title' has a higher priority.
        icon: 'success',
        duration: 2000,
        success(res) {
           console.log(res);
        }
     });
  }

  function saveBase64Image() {
     // Support promise
     ma.saveBase64Image({ base64: 'xxxx' }).then(res => {
        console.log(res);
     });

     // Support callback
     ma.saveBase64Image({
        base64: 'xxxx',
        success(res) {
           console.log(res);
        },
        fail(err) {
           console.log(err);
        },
        complete(res) {
           console.log(res);
        }
     });
  }

  function saveImage() {
     // Support promise
     ma.saveImage({ content: 'xxxx' }).then(res => {
        console.log(res.result);
     });

     // Support callback
     ma.saveImage({
        content: 'xxxx',
        success(res) {
           console.log(res.result);
        },
